asterisms.gloss: The fixed pole; holds latitude and heading, shot with the kamal. The star that does not move.
A bright southern star whose low altitude over the palm line marks approach to an island's latitude.
Its dawn rising marks the monsoon shoulder — the season to haul the jong out and stop voyaging.
The bright morning star that opens the sailing day and times the change of watch on a night crossing.
The luminous band of the night sky, steered along as a heading-line on moonless, star-clear nights.
Foreign fixed-points the Qollari name as ancestors; the nakhoda borrows their positions to time corridor access, not their genealogy.
Nakhoda chart-oath sworn on Serakar, the star that does not move; a name-plate device, not a figure.
asterisms.etymology: pidgin oath attested in the sky-mandate; bound to sera + kar (the Crown Star)
